choices.content: Select only students on the basketball team
Select only the tallest student in each class
Randomly select students from the entire school

question.prompt: To estimate the mean height of all students in a school, which of the following sampling methods is the most reasonable? ( )

solutions.explanation: Random selection gives every student an equal chance of being selected, helping avoid systematic selection bias, although an individual sample may still be unrepresentative by chance. The other methods restrict selection by team membership, grade, or height and risk bias. Therefore, choose D.
solutions.title: Compare sampling bias
